name: zcode-app-cli
description: Unofficial terminal client for the ZCode agent runtime
author: Kingsword kingsword09 <kingsword09@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: bun run sync:local && ZCODE_NODE=node bun bin/zcode.ts
scripts.sync:locked: bun run build && bun scripts/sync-runtime.ts --lock zcode-runtime.lock.json
scripts.check:tui: bun scripts/smoke-tui.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-features.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-clear.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-session-title.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-pressure.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-widths.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-fullscreen.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-fullscreen-switch.ts && bun scripts/smoke-tui-fullscreen-layout.ts
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit && bun run test:tui && bun run test:runtime
scripts.test:tui: bun run test:tui:component && bun run test:tui:e2e
scripts.test:tui:component: bun test test/tui/scenario-http.test.ts test/tui/scenario-runtime.test.ts test/tui/scenario-shell.test.ts test/tui/scenario-workspace.test.ts test/tui/terminal-screen.test.ts
scripts.test:tui:e2e: bun test test/tui/allowlisted-shell.test.ts test/tui/http-mock.test.ts test/tui/model-resume.test.ts test/tui/permission-request-queue.test.ts test/tui/run-scenario.test.ts test/tui/session-rename.test.ts test/tui/terminal-session.test.ts test/tui/write-and-diff.test.ts
